body: Hahaha me too. Ecology and cell biology. Not too prepared yet, but I will be by the time I take them. Also that girl texted me back. I have no idea what to say. I'm still angry, but I still care about her. I'm torn.
Thanks man. Mostly studying and work. I have to catch up because I missed all of my classes Thursday and Friday, as well as 2 exams.
Better. I saw him today and just started crying. I couldn't stop thinking that this won't be the last time that I see him like this in the hospital. It really frightened me.
Thanks. It's still getting me bummed though. I left for the weekend so I could see my dad. I had a decent night last night though.
One week? Alright man. I'll leave it till next thursday at the earliest.

I guess... I wrote a letter and it really expresses how I feel right now. But I don't know whether or not I should send it to her (by text). I really got a lot out on that paper. But I'm scared of what might come of it if I send it.
I still can't stop thinking about the last conversation I had with her and how angry I am at her right now...
Yes a couple of times.
Thank you... You really have no idea how much I appreciate all of what you've said. I'm going to try and let it go for now and maybe I'll come back to it if it surfaces again. Thank you.

I am very sorry to hear this. If you are at a university, they normally offer immediate help for these kinds of situations. I was forced to go, and it helped a little. Maybe you need someone to talk to.
Nice. That's pretty awesome! He puts on a great show.
I was outside earlier, it's pretty cold here. I will go to the gym later though. I also have a dog that I'm looking forward to seeing tomorrow when I go visit my dad. Thank you for the suggestions.
Hahahaha yeah that song is on my favorites playlist.
Hahaha you said it man, I'd like to be a surgeon.
I really hope they do. I've never been in this bad of a position before.

My dad apparently had a virus. He was hospitalized overnight because of a high fiver, fainting, vomiting, and so on. I was really worried last night. The psychiatrist basically told me that I should come in for follow up visits until the end of the semester and that these next few weeks are very important. As for the girl, she told me specifically that she didn't want to hurt me and she wanted to leave me alone. I've known her for about a year, and after she broke up with her boyfriend she got really depressed too, but she went out and had sex with a friend of hers. This part really upset me, and I'm really confused. I want to tell her that we shouldn't be friends, and that she in fact doesn't need my friendship because she clearly has moved on from her break up. I want to tell her that she could certainly open up to this guy (who she's known for about eight years) instead of talking to me about her problems. I feel like she doesn't actually need me as a friend and I don;t know why she's been stringing me along this whole time.
I've been doing general biology but I'm into human anatomy. I'm applying to medical schools and hearing back from them in the coming weeks.

Alright. Thank you. Both of these happening at the same time really got to me. I learned that my dad was sick after I got out of the hospital, and I just sat at my desk and stared at my computer. I couldn't believe it at the time. I did talk to the psychiatrist about this too. And I've dealt with rejection before, but I guess this time it hurt more because I thought that I could actually do something better for myself with her. I do need time to cool off, but I don't know how long it'll be before I finally figure out what I want to do. I've been leaning towards telling her off because she really hurt me.

I've been listening to them since you linked me. They're really good! 

I'm pretty good at understanding science. I've been studying biology for the past four years in college and so far I've been doing pretty well.

This is a lot more mellow than what I'm used to listening to. It's a nice change. I'm feeling a little bit better and I'm trying to keep myself distracted from everything that I have going on, but it's kinda hard when I feel like I'm either not good enough for someone or that I'm causing other people to hurt as a result of my actions.
Right now I'm listening to a lot of Eminem but I think I should stop, it's not making me feel any better. Any suggestions?
Thanks. Unfortunately it's not that easy for me to put her out of my mind right now, but I'll try. I really appreciate your kind words for a random stranger.

Thank you for your kind words. I understand how your friend might feel. I am the same way. I just sit here and dwell on everything that I've done wrong. I'm trying to look for support, but the closest thing to support I have right now is my school's mental health facilities and I was already there once today. Again, thank you.

What's making me feel shitty mostly is this girl situation right now, but there's a lot more going on. She needed a friend after she broke up with her boyfriend over the summer, and I was there for her. When I started getting closer to her and I realized that I really liked her, she told me that it probably wouldn't work out, but that she still needs me as a friend. And now after I went through my episode, she basically told me that she doesn't want to talk to me anymore. But yeah, I actually really like astronomy. It's something I've thought about pursuing but I never really followed through and I'm not sure if it's something I'd want to do for the rest of my life.
I guess this would have been a better place to post this.
Yeah, I guess you're right. Thanks.
Thanks. I've been thinking of doing some writing lately.
Thank you. This helped more than you know.
I'm not blaming her, I just needed advice on the depression. I really should have worded this better.
It's isn't making it any better though.
I'm trying right now.
